parts.text: Everything in this thread is a Hub widget drawn from fictional demo data — scroll for every widget kind this build draws.
Starting with the small ones: a status card and a single headline number.
Two ways to show a series over time: a chart, and the same week as a table when you want the exact numbers.
A plan in flight, and next to it an event log — same rows, different shapes: a checklist is something to do, a timeline is something that happened.

props.title: demo package history
props.caption: a timeline, not a to-do list

parts.text: And two that pull a real sense of the day: the week ahead, and the weather over it.
Last three: a button row, a poll and a form. In chat these draw but return nothing when tapped — only server-rendered pages can post back, so they sit here as honest examples of that.

thread.title: Trip planning with Xavier
thread.preview: Both fit the budget. The cabin needs booking two weeks out; the town is flexible. I left a decision card for the dates.

parts.text: Xavier and I are comparing two weekends for the demo trip — coastal town or mountain cabin?
Two options on the board: the coastal town (mild, walkable) or the mountain cabin (quiet, longer drive). Want me to compare costs?
Yes, compare them and flag anything that needs booking early.
Both fit the budget. The cabin needs booking two weeks out; the town is flexible. I left a decision card for the dates.

thread.title: Demo hub tour
thread.preview: Try the Brief tab, then Ops (cron + kanban) and the Cost page. Anything you change stays on this iPhone.

parts.text: Welcome to the demo Hub. Every number here is fictional — poke around freely.
What can I look at first?
Try the Brief tab, then Ops (cron + kanban) and the Cost page. Anything you change stays on this iPhone.

Good. Add a staging option too.
